headline: Chinese Independent Refiners Turn to Iraqi Crude Amid US Blockade on Iran
summary: Independent oil refiners in China are purchasing Iraqi crude oil via international commodity trading houses as US naval blockades severely constrain Iranian crude shipments.
why: China is the largest global importer of crude oil. Shifts in refining procurement modify regional crude trade routes, spot tanker rates, and Middle Eastern benchmark pricing differentials.

impacts.name: Iraq
impacts.why: Increased purchase orders from Chinese refiners boost demand for Iraqi spot oil cargoes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
